FN-CX75PJW-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 154
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/05/2026
Senate Bill 154 as introduced would provide a two percent salary increase for state employees,
effective on the first pay day during fiscal year 2027, which would increase the personnel costs
of state agencies by an estimated $60.0 million in fiscal year 2027 and each fiscal year
thereafter, with an estimated $16.0 million of this increase paid from the State General Fund.
